import struct

print("len",len(d))
ptype=d[0]
freeblock=struct.unpack('>H',d[1:3])[0]
ncells=struct.unpack('>H',d[3:5])[0]
content=struct.unpack('>H',d[5:7])[0]
frag=d[7]
print("ptype",ptype,"freeblock",freeblock,"ncells",ncells,"content",content,"frag",frag)
ptrs=[struct.unpack('>H',d[8+2*i:10+2*i])[0] for i in range(ncells)]
print("ptrs",ptrs)

def varint(b,i):
    v=0
    for j in range(9):
        c=b[i+j]
        v=(v<<7)|(c&0x7f)
        if not (c&0x80):
            return v,i+j+1
    return v,i+9

def serial_len(t):
    if t==0: return 0
    if t<=4: return t
    if t==5: return 6
    if t==6 or t==7: return 8
    if t==8 or t==9: return 0
    if t>=12: return (t-12)//2 if t%2==0 else (t-13)//2
    raise ValueError(t)

def decode(t,body,off):
    if t==0: return None,off
    if t==1: return struct.unpack('>b',body[off:off+1])[0],off+1
    if t==2: return struct.unpack('>h',body[off:off+2])[0],off+2
    if t==3: 
        v=body[off]<<16|body[off+1]<<8|body[off+2]
        if v>=0x800000: v-=0x1000000
        return v,off+3
    if t==4: return struct.unpack('>i',body[off:off+4])[0],off+4
    if t==5: return struct.unpack('>q',body[off:off+6]+b'\x00\x00')[0],off+6
    if t==6: return struct.unpack('>q',body[off:off+8])[0],off+8
    if t==7: return struct.unpack('>d',body[off:off+8])[0],off+8
    if t==8: return 0,off
    if t==9: return 1,off
    n=serial_len(t)
    if t%2==0:
        return int.from_bytes(body[off:off+n],'big'),off+n
    return body[off:off+n].decode('utf-8','replace'),off+n

import json, struct

d=open('/app/trunc.db','rb').read()

def varint(b,i):
    v=0
    for j in range(9):
        c=b[i+j]; v=(v<<7)|(c&0x7f)
        if not c&0x80: return v,i+j+1

def decode(t,b,o):
    if t==0: return None,o
    if t==1: return struct.unpack('>b',b[o:o+1])[0],o+1
    if t==2: return struct.unpack('>h',b[o:o+2])[0],o+2
    if t==3:
        v=(b[o]<<16)|(b[o+1]<<8)|b[o+2]
        return (v-0x1000000 if v>=0x800000 else v),o+3
    if t==4: return struct.unpack('>i',b[o:o+4])[0],o+4
    if t==5: return struct.unpack('>q',b[o:o+6]+b'\0\0')[0],o+6
    if t==6: return struct.unpack('>q',b[o:o+8])[0],o+8
    if t==7: return struct.unpack('>d',b[o:o+8])[0],o+8
    if t==8: return 0,o
    if t==9: return 1,o
    n=(t-12)//2 if t%2==0 else (t-13)//2
    return (int.from_bytes(b[o:o+n],'big') if t%2==0 else b[o:o+n].decode()),o+n

ncells=struct.unpack('>H',d[3:5])[0]
ptrs=[struct.unpack('>H',d[8+2*i:10+2*i])[0] for i in range(ncells)]
rows=[]
for p in ptrs:
    plen,i=varint(d,p); rowid,i=varint(d,i)
    pay=d[i:i+plen]; hl,j=varint(pay,0); types=[]
    while j<hl:
        t,j=varint(pay,j); types.append(t)
    o=hl; vals=[]
    for t in types:
        v,o=decode(t,pay,o); vals.append(v)
    # schema: (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, word TEXT, value) -> id stored NULL
    rows.append({"word": vals[1], "value": vals[2]})
rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["word"])
with open('/app/recover.json','w') as f:
    json.dump(rows,f,indent=2)
print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
